title.narrative: Development of renewable energy in fragile states

description.narrative:
The agreement falls under Norad’s Enterprise Development in Renewable Energy Support Scheme for developing countries.
Kube Energy supplies electricity from off-grid energy solutions so communities, government agencies, businesses and organizations can access clean energy, reduce energy costs, streamline operations and lower carbon emissions.
The project consists of feasibility studies around new solar mini-grids at sites in the Central African Republic (CAR and South Sudan.
The primary beneficiaries of these efforts are the people of CAR and South Sudan.
